snippet.title: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition – Nintendo Direct 9.12.2025
snippet.description:
ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition launches fall 2025. 

Heroes, Foes, Legends, and more from across the World of ONE PIECE collide once more!
